pcs.pc_description: select high-yielding and pest and disease- resistant varieties of oil-yielding spice crops for cultivation

pcs.pc_description: carry out ploughing and harrowing in the field for the recommended number of times to achieve a fine tilth

prepare stolons for planting, cutting them into pieces of appropriate length

pcs.pc_description: select a site with the recommended sunlight exposure, temperature and rainfall for the cultivation of saffron
check the site is located at an appropriate altitude suitable for the cultivation of saffron
check the soil at the site is appropriately textured and well-drained with the recommended pH
determine the availability of required inputs, such as planting material, fertilizers and labour at the site
identify the appropriate sources, e.g. Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), agricultural universities and government-approved vendors, to procure saffron corms for saffron cultivation
check the quality of saffron corms to ensure they have the appropriate characteristics, e.g. recommended weight, for successful flowering and healthy growth
procure saffron corms in the required quantity and store them under the recommended temperature and humidity to maintain their quality
identify and sort out the injured and diseased corms, if any
remove the outer scales of corms before planting
treat corms using the appropriate treatment before planting to control corm rot infection and other soil borne diseases
dry the treated corms in shade for the recommended duration to achieve the appropriate moisture levels

modules.module_title: Prepare the field and plant saffron corms

pcs.pc_description: identify and remove debris and waste material from the field before ploughing
carry out deep ploughing in the field to remove weeds and roots and achieve the recommended tilth
carry out planking to crush the hard clods, smoothen the soil surface and compact the soil lightly
create drainage channels in the field to drain excess water and prevent waterlogging in saffron field
install the appropriate irrigation system in saffron field, e.g. sprinkler irrigation system to irrigate the saffron crop
plant saffron corms in rows at the recommended spacing and depth, following the recommended seed rate
maintain saffron corms in the correct position while planting them
provide appropriate care to the planted saffron corms, e.g. application of water and recommended fertilizers
determine the water requirements of saffron plants based on their stage of growth and climatic conditions
carry out irrigation with the appropriate quantity of water, following the recommended irrigation schedule
carry out hoeing in the saffron field at the recommended intervals to ensure effective soil aeration for the healthy growth of saffron plants
adopt Integrated Nutrient Management (INM) strategies for the optimum growth of saffron plants
apply the recommended manures and bio- fertilizers in the recommended quantity to achieve the healthy growth of saffron plants
follow the recommended fertilizer application method, e.g. band application, and appropriate schedule as per the INM strategy
check the saffron field for infestation by rodent pests, e.g. rats and porcupines, and follow the appropriate control methods, such as fumigation of burrows to repel rodents and closing burrows
follow the appropriate pest and disease control measures, such as the adoption of natural enemies of saffron insect and mite pests, e.g. lacewing, ladybird beetle, predatory thrips, etc.
identify the symptoms of disease infestation in saffron plants, e.g. corm rot/dry rot, bacterial rot, bulb rot, and root rot, in saffron plants
select and prepare the appropriate pesticide treatment and apply it in the recommended quantity to eliminate saffron crop pests and diseases
follow the pesticide label instructions for the safe and effective application of pesticides, e.g. use of appropriate personal protection and plant protection equipment
identify and remove weeds growing among the saffron plants
carry out weeding at the recommended intervals using the appropriate weeding tools and implements
identify the maturity indices of saffron flowers
pick saffron flowers after the recommended duration following their emergence
maintain the appropriate hygiene standards while picking saffron flowers, e.g. use of gloves and collect them appropriate containers, such as craft paper bags ad willow baskets
separate the stigma of saffron flowers within the recommended duration after flower picking to achieve the optimum pistil recovery
dry saffron at the recommended temperature using hot air dryer or solar dryer, to achieve the appropriate texture and flavour
pack the dry saffron in air-tight containers, maintaining the recommended moisture content
store the packed saffron at the recommended temperature ensuring hygienic conditions for its optimum shelf life
identify the buyers of saffron, such as procurement agencies, traders, exporters, etc.
negotiate with the identified buyer(s) to secure a profitable price for the crop
arrange an appropriate mode of transport to deliver saffron to the buyer
follow the recommended measures to protect saffron from contamination during its handling and transporting them
process the payments using the appropriate payment method including e-payment methods
calculate the benefit-cost (B:C) ratio
maintain the manual and/or electronic record of sales and payments using the physical registers and/or the relevant computer application
